claims: Fred Hoiberg was named the 2026 Big Ten Coach of the Year by the conference coaches.
Fred Hoiberg was a Naismith Coach of the Year semifinalist.
Under Coach Hoiberg, the 2025-26 Cornhuskers achieved their first NCAA Tournament win in school history.
The 2025-26 Cornhuskers defeated Troy 76-47.
The 2025-26 team established school records for total wins with 27 wins.
The 2025-26 team established school records for conference wins with 15 wins.
Hoiberg signed a contract extension in March 2026.
Hoiberg's contract extension boosts his salary to $5 million per year starting April 1, 2026.
Fred Hoiberg signed an extension through 2026-27 with a $5 million+ salary.
Sam Hoiberg is a senior guard for the Huskers.
In the 2025-26 season, Sam Hoiberg averaged 9.7 points.
In the 2025-26 season, Sam Hoiberg averaged 5.2 rebounds.
In the 2025-26 season, Sam Hoiberg averaged 4.4 assists.
In the 2025-26 season, Sam Hoiberg averaged 2.1 steals.
Sam Hoiberg often started for the team.
Sam Hoiberg is a multiple-time Academic All-Big Ten recipient.
Sam Hoiberg is a multiple-time Big Ten Distinguished Scholar recipient.
Fred Hoiberg joined Nebraska in 2019.
Fred Hoiberg was the head coach for the Chicago Bulls from 2015 to 2018.
Fred Hoiberg was the head coach for Iowa State from 2010 to 2015.
Fred Hoiberg played in the NBA for 10 seasons with the Indiana Pacers, Chicago Bulls, and Minnesota Timberwolves from 1995 to 2005.
Fred Hoiberg was nicknamed "The Mayor" during his college playing days at Iowa State.
